## 2. Ready-to-paste comment / annotation

a(9)-a(10) computed by an exact treewidth-3 renormalization of the matching generating polynomial P(x)=Sum_M x^{|M|} on the recursively-built Apollonian 3-tree, reading off the leading coefficient (a windowed top-coefficient transfer keeps the maximum-cardinality count exactly). The program reproduces every previously published b-file term (a(1)..a(8)) exactly, and each new term was independently verified by two distinct implementations (a second, independently-authored program using a different formulation) that agree digit-for-digit.
